stem: A Focalin prescription from a properly registered New Hampshire prescriber was issued four days ago and can be verified. Which conclusion is most defensible?

choices.text: Use the out-of-state prescription rule when its schedule, age, and verification conditions have not been checked.
Process another refill because an authorization written by the prescriber overrides schedule limits.
The nonnarcotic Schedule II out-of-state pathway may permit dispensing after verification.
Treat the request as an insufficient-stock partial fill and use the 72-hour remainder rule.
Handle the drug or transaction as ordinary Massachusetts Schedule VI activity.

explanation.core_reasoning: Massachusetts applies a five-day presentation window and different issuing-state conditions to out-of-state narcotic and nonnarcotic Schedule II prescriptions. dexmethylphenidate (Focalin) is used for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
